title: The Free Kick That Turned
coreQuestion: How did Roberto Carlos's 1997 free kick bend the way it did?

facts.claim: In the 21st minute of the opening match between France and Brazil, Roberto Carlos scored his Banana Shot free kick, curling from long distance, often considered one of the best in the modern game.
He struck the free kick against France with the outside of his left foot.
Roberto Carlos struck the free kick with the outside of his left foot.
France goalkeeper Fabien Barthez did not move as the ball went in.

narration.text: One of the best free kicks of the modern game.
1997. The opening match, France against Brazil.
Roberto Carlos struck it from long distance.
It curled, and it became known as the Banana Shot.
